long_biography.plain_text:
Shipowner John Dragnis has favoured securing cargo and charter employment before committing to fleet expansion. As Goldenport's commercial director, he sought closer relationships with bulk-cargo producers, including steelmakers, beyond the traders who had supplied much of its business. He treated those relationships as a gradual exercise in earning customers' confidence.

At Golden Yachts, his approach to commercial construction starts with clients' daily routines. He emphasises how private spaces and unobtrusive crew routes allow customers to use a yacht freely. The yard works with specialist designers and craftspeople to translate those requirements into layouts and interiors.
